issues: Some terms are translated inconsistently, e.g. 'UI automation' is translated as 'автоматизация пользовательского интерфейса' in some places and as 'автоматизация UI' in others. 'Go' is translated as 'Go' in some places and as 'Go' in others. 'QA' is translated as 'QA' in some places and as 'QA' in others. 'CI' is translated as 'CI' in some places and as 'CI' in others. 'DOM' is translated as 'DOM' in some place and as 'DOM' in another. 'async' is translated as 'асинхронные' in one place and as 'async' in another. 'diff' is translated as 'дифф' in one place and as 'дифф' in another. 'replay' is translated as 'воспроизведение' in one place and as 'replay' in another. 'buffer' is translated as 'буфер' in one place and as 'buffer' in another.
